import datetime,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
SOURCE=Path('/tmp/onnax-context-source')
ROOT=Path('/Users/justinc/Documents/GitHub/onnax')
RUN=Path('/tmp/onnax-real-context-256')
LIBRARY=Path('/tmp/onnax-inverse-target/release/libonnxruntime_mlx_ep.dylib')
PYTHON=str(ROOT/'.venv/bin/python')
COMMIT='0f2d0103e951d7d68e2b00cccb6b6c4aa5c0d584'
CORE='808ebdde8c36c55b60be666f86c158f3edb6ea5e211bfd0ce7e9e31c1b338910'
LIB='bbdfe266ec628e133e8db4ff317076e0fe40e6f3bb36efb66b6283c3b7ef4087'
def now():return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def save(path,data):path.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
def check():
 assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=SOURCE,text=True).strip()==COMMIT
 assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=SOURCE,text=True).strip()
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 for p in sorted((ROOT/'src/onnax').rglob('*.py')):
  h.update(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).encode());h.update(p.read_bytes())
 assert h.hexdigest()==CORE
 assert hashlib.sha256(LIBRARY.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==LIB
if RUN.exists():raise SystemExit('Run directory exists; inspect its handle before any new launch')
assert json.loads(Path('/tmp/onnax-real-evaluation/sequence.json').read_text())['status']=='complete'
assert json.loads(Path('/tmp/onnax-no-robots-quality/sequence.json').read_text())['status']=='complete'
assert json.loads(Path('/tmp/onnax-real-raw-optimized/sequence.json').read_text())['status']=='complete'
check();RUN.mkdir()
state={'status':'running','source_commit':COMMIT,'core_source_sha256':CORE,'library_sha256':LIB,'started':now(),'jobs':[]};save(RUN/'sequence.json',state)
try:
 for mode in ['pytorch','optimized','chunked','joint']:
  check();prefix=RUN/mode
  command=[PYTHON,'-m','examples.huggingface.benchmark','--mode',mode,'--real','--nf4','--provider','mlx','--library',str(LIBRARY),'--batch-size','1','--sequence-length','256','--chunk-size','128','--warmup','10','--samples','100']
  record={'mode':mode,'command':command,'source_commit':COMMIT,'core_source_sha256':CORE,'library_sha256':LIB,'started':now(),'operational_memory_limit_bytes':24*1024**3,'observations':[]}
  state['jobs'].append({'mode':mode,'status':'running','journal':str(prefix)+'.run.json'});save(RUN/'sequence.json',state)
  print(json.dumps({'stage':'start','mode':mode}),flush=True)
  with open(str(prefix)+'.json','w') as output,open(str(prefix)+'.log','w') as log:
   child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=SOURCE,env={**os.environ,'HF_HUB_OFFLINE':'1','ONNXRUNTIME_EP_MLX_NO_COMPILE':'1'},stdout=output,stderr=log)
   record['pid']=child.pid;save(Path(str(prefix)+'.run.json'),record)
   while child.poll() is None:
    try:
     snapshot=subprocess.run(['vmmap','-summary',str(child.pid)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
     matches=re.findall(r'Physical footprint[^:]*:\s*([0-9.]+)([KMG])',snapshot.stdout) if snapshot.returncode==0 else []
     values=[float(n)*1024**{'K':1,'M':2,'G':3}[u] for n,u in matches]
     if values:
      record['observations'].append({'utc':now(),'current_bytes':values[0],'peak_bytes':max(values)})
      if max(values)>record['operational_memory_limit_bytes']:
       record['guard_triggered']=True;(RUN/f'{mode}-guard.vmmap').write_text(snapshot.stdout)
       child.terminate()
       try:child.wait(timeout=15)
       except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:child.kill();child.wait()
       break
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:record['last_observation_error']='vmmap timeout; same child retained'
    save(Path(str(prefix)+'.run.json'),record);time.sleep(15)
   record.update(returncode=child.wait(),finished=now());save(Path(str(prefix)+'.run.json'),record)
  state['jobs'][-1].update(status='complete' if record['returncode']==0 else 'failed',returncode=record['returncode']);save(RUN/'sequence.json',state)
  assert record['returncode']==0 and not record.get('guard_triggered',False),'Benchmark failed'
  report=json.loads(Path(str(prefix)+'.json').read_text())
  assert report['samples']==100 and report['warmup']==10 and report['valid_shifted_tokens']==255 and report['sequence']==256
  assert len(report['losses'])==110
  assert report['mode']==mode and report['ort_optimizer']=='disabled'
  print(json.dumps({'stage':'finish','mode':mode,'returncode':0}),flush=True)
 reports=[json.loads((RUN/f'{mode}.json').read_text()) for mode in ['pytorch','optimized','chunked','joint']]
 assert len({r['input_ids_sha256'] for r in reports})==1
 state.update(status='complete',finished=now());save(RUN/'sequence.json',state)
except BaseException as error:
 state.update(status='failed',error=str(error),finished=now());save(RUN/'sequence.json',state)
 raise

assert state['status']=='complete' and len(state['jobs'])==4
components=[];executions=[]
for mode in ['pytorch','optimized','chunked','joint']:
 report=json.loads((RUN/f'{mode}.json').read_text())

 if mode!='pytorch':assert report['library_sha256']==state['library_sha256']
